notes.title: METAVUSKING Update Plan
notes.notes:
METAVUSKING will be officially released with an update on April 28, 2022. There are still many shortcomings, but we promise to make up for them in the future. 

As for the progress and future update plans, a community based on vocal data was considered as a major function of METAVUSKING since its inception. The basic function is to share the recorded vocal data with other players through the server and use it to proceed with the duet mode. These features are essential to the server, but the cost of the server system is higher than expected, delaying the update of related features. We are trying to solve problems such as funding, so please continue to support and cheer us on!

The upcoming updates are as follows:

1. Partner Studio
- You can record the vocal data of a duet in the recording studio and share it over the Internet.
- If other players sing duet songs with the vocal data you shared, you can get a reward.

2. Upgraded Solo Mode
- A total of 40,000 additional songs including K-POP, POP, and J-POP will be provided.
- As many songs were added, the UI related to solo mode is revamped for easy and fast song selection.

3. Virtual Idols
- Idols will debut at METAVUSKING Universe through artificial intelligence-based vocaloid technology!!
- With the appearance of virtual idols, you can choose even more songs in duet mode.

4. Theater Editor
- You can decorate your own concert hall by combining various objects and backgrounds.
- Shoot a new concert video with a unique venue in the background!

5. Coin system
- If you spend one coin, you can perform songs that you haven't bought yet.
- Coins can be purchased through Microtransactions (In-Game Purchases).
